Finishing Solution

Engineered for both aesthetics and durability, Buildrite’s finishing range—including skimcoats and renders—complies with European Standards (EN) for adhesion and compressive strength. These solutions ensure high pull-off strength (verified via ASTM D4541 testing) to prevent delamination. They provide a smooth, crack-resistant base, reducing the need for heavy sanding while meeting global requirements for surface regularity.
